monitoring_sources.name: Oficina de Gerencia de Permisos (OGPe)
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Primary public OGPe landing page. Use it to discover public instructions and route authenticated or transactional permit workflows to SBP when appropriate.

monitoring_sources.name: Single Business Portal
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Portal is likely authentication-gated. Monitor public login/help text, public workflow labels, and linked guidance; do not scrape private account data.

monitoring_sources.name: Departamento de Hacienda - Planillas, Formularios y Anejos
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: High-value source for downloadable forms and tax-related instructions. Preserve form numbers, tax year, revision date, and PDF/download URLs.

monitoring_sources.name: Departamento de Hacienda - Comerciantes
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Use as a topical entry point for business-facing Hacienda requirements and links into specific forms.

monitoring_sources.name: Departamento de Estado - Registro de Corporaciones y Entidades
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Monitor for filing instructions, annual report requirements, corporation forms, and links to the official electronic registry.

monitoring_sources.name: Departamento de Salud
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Use as the main official health-agency domain and discover downloadable CMS documents, requirements, and program pages.

monitoring_sources.name: Salud Digital
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Authentication-gated portal; monitor public service descriptions and help content, then route users rather than scraping account-only records.

monitoring_sources.name: Oficina de Reglamentación y Certificación de Profesionales de la Salud
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Monitor public licensing categories and renewal guidance for health professionals.

monitoring_sources.name: Cuerpo de Bomberos - Formularios
monitoring_sources.agency: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Puerto Rico
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Good source for PDFs and required-document sheets. Preserve document titles, publication/revision dates, and direct PDF URLs.

monitoring_sources.name: DRNA - Formularios
monitoring_sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Monitor category pages and paginated archives for new or revised environmental forms.

monitoring_sources.name: DRNA - Permisos
monitoring_sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Specific permit-form category; prioritize over broader DRNA archive when extracting form candidates.

monitoring_sources.name: DRNA - Área Calidad de Aire / Permisos
monitoring_sources.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Target for air-emissions requirements; capture email-only instructions separately from downloadable forms.

monitoring_sources.name: Puerto Rico Tourism Company
monitoring_sources.agency: Compañía de Turismo de Puerto Rico
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Monitor business, room-tax, program, laws, and regulations pages for tourism-sector obligations.

monitoring_sources.name: Puerto Rico Tourism Company - Doing Business
monitoring_sources.agency: Compañía de Turismo de Puerto Rico
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Use as a business-facing landing page for tourism-related compliance and program links.

monitoring_sources.name: CRIM 360
monitoring_sources.agency: Centro de Recaudaciones de Ingresos Municipales
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Portal content may be account-gated. Monitor public service descriptions and certification types; do not scrape taxpayer accounts.

monitoring_sources.name: Corporación del Fondo del Seguro del Estado
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Monitor employer transaction pages and certificate guidance for workers-compensation proof documents.

monitoring_sources.name: ASUME - Solicitud de Certificación de Cumplimiento Patronal
monitoring_sources.agency: Administración para el Sustento de Menores / Departamento de la Familia
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Public form page for employer compliance certification. Capture field requirements and submission instructions where publicly visible.

monitoring_sources.name: PR.gov Gobierno Digital
monitoring_sources.agency: Puerto Rico Innovation and Technology Service / PR.gov
monitoring_sources.extraction_notes: Use as a discovery index to identify official service portals; verify extracted requirements against the destination agency site.
